onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const practitionerLabel = qIndividualProfile.data?.[0]?.practitioner_singular_label || 'Practitioner'; const selected = tblIndividualPractitionerAssignments.selectedRow; if (!selected?.member_practitioner_assignment_id || selected.assignment_status !== 'active') { showAlert('Select an active ' + practitionerLabel.toLowerCase() + ' assignment.', 'warning'); return; } const rows = await qEndIndividualPractitioner.run({ assignment_id: selected.member_practitioner_assignment_id, reason: inpIndividualPractitionerReason.text?.trim() }); if (!rows?.[0]?.member_practitioner_assignment_id) throw new Error('No assignment was returned.'); await Promise.all([qIndividualPractitionerAssignments.run(), qIndividualAvailablePractitioners.run(), qIndividualMemberOperationsState.run()]); resetWidget('inpIndividualPractitionerReason', true); showAlert(practitionerLabel + ' assignment ended.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Ending assignment failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
